subject: Network Systems
cutoff: The (synthetic) lesson plan states the mid-semester coverage as the first 23 lectures: units Data Communications, Application Layer and Transport Layer are in scope; later units and topics found only in older plans are out.

exam_pattern.structure: Answer any four questions including Q1 (compulsory). Q1: 5 x 1 mark; answer any 3 of Q2-Q5, 5 marks each. 2025: Q2-Q4 split 3 + 2 marks, Q5 = short notes on any two of three (2.5 x 2). 2022/2024: each 2.5 + 2.5

figure_plan.desc: OSI 7 layers beside the TCP/IP 5 layers, with the PDU name (message, segment/user datagram, datagram, frame, bits) and address type (names, ports, IP, MAC) per layer [N p24-25]
Encapsulation down the sender stack and decapsulation up the receiver stack: each layer adds its header, payload = upper-layer PDU [N p60]
Space-time diagram of one packet on a link: transmission time L/R, then propagation d/s; RTT = 2 x propagation [N p91]
Sliding send window over an m-bit sequence-number strip: Sf, Sn, Ssize; regions acked / outstanding / can send / cannot send; wrap-around [N p66-67]
UDP 8-byte header (source port, destination port, length, checksum) in 32-bit rows, plus the checksum pseudoheader [N p72, p74]
TCP header in 32-bit rows: ports, sequence, acknowledgment, HLEN, reserved, flags URG ACK PSH RST SYN FIN, window, checksum, urgent pointer, options [N p78]
Three-way handshake timeline client/server: SYN, SYN+ACK, ACK with seq/ack numbers and the state each side enters [N p80, p86]
TCP state transition diagram: client path (solid) and server path (dashed), CLOSED to TIME-WAIT / LAST-ACK [N p84]
cwnd (MSS) vs RTT: slow start doubling to ssthresh, linear congestion avoidance, multiplicative decrease sawtooth [N p87-90]
